items.caption: This oracle-script-style form has an elongated lower stroke and a notched upper shape. Its precise referent is disputed; proposed readings include a marked blade or tool, while the traditional paired-boats explanation is not confirmed by the early forms.
items.alt: Black oracle-script-style form of 方, with an elongated lower stroke and an irregular upper shape.
items.selection_reason: Shows the early graphic candidate relevant to competing interpretations of 方’s origin; the visible shape alone cannot settle what it depicts.

items.caption: This Shuowen seal-script-style form has a curved upper section crossing a long horizontal stroke and a descending lower stroke. The Shuowen tradition explained 方 as abbreviated paired boats, but that account is a historical interpretation rather than proof of the graph’s original referent.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style form of 方, with curved upper strokes, a long horizontal stroke, and a descending lower stroke.
items.selection_reason: Adds the traditional dictionary form and makes its paired-boats explanation relevant for comparison with the disputed early-form analyses.

limitations.text: The early form’s depicted object remains unresolved among competing tool, blade, implement, and boat interpretations. The seal-style form illustrates a dictionary tradition; neither shape alone establishes the graph’s original meaning or a sequence of semantic change.
